plugins.name: terminal-pet
plugins.description: A pixel-art crab above the prompt that reacts live to what Claude is doing. /pet for commands.

plugins.name: coral-skin
plugins.description: Coral, ink and cream reskin of Claude Code with risk-coded tool rows. Toggle with /skin.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Context window and session cost meter, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: repo-heatmap
plugins.description: Watch where Claude looks: a live treemap of the repo that lights up as files are read, searched and edited.

plugins.name: flight-recorder
plugins.description: See inside a turn: a live Gantt timeline of model requests, tool calls and subagents, with tokens and cost per lane.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Route supported subagent work to Sonnet or Haiku while keeping the main conversation on its model. /router for controls.

plugins.name: output-tray
plugins.description: A side panel of the files this session created, with Open, Reveal in Finder and Copy path.

plugins.name: changes-receipt
plugins.description: A plain-English receipt after every turn: files created, changed and deleted, by tool or via shell, with failed attempts listed apart.

plugins.name: session-bookmarks
plugins.description: Explicit bookmarks for Claude Code sessions you want to come back to. /bm saves one, /bm open lists them with a copyable resume command.

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: Writes a cold-start handoff to handoff/ before the context fills up or compacts, and offers to resume from it in the next session.
